buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Yantra India Limited Ordnance Factory Bhusawal . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date

4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA 1. The contractor/vendors who has successfully completed Phosphating/ Painting/ Processing services will be considered eligible to participate in tender. 2. The contractors/vendors are required to submit proof of successfully completed similar type of supply or ders through tendering/LPC in the past in any Ordnance factories. 3. Definition of similar work: Phosphating/ Painting/Phosphating & Painting/ powder coating/ surface treatm ent/ Electroplating/ Galvanizing/ Tinning/ Pickling/ De-rusting/ De-scaling/ Chemical Processing etc. 4. Supplier must confirm the supply of sufficient manpower for processing minimum Qty. of boxes per day per shift as per scope of work. 5. Firm shall submit compliance of O.F. Bhusawal specification duly signed and stamped . 6. Non-compliance of above terms and conditions may result in termination of participation and offer of the Firm will be liable for rejection. 7. Tender without submission of above supporting documents will be summarily rejected and no further correspondence in this regard will be made. Note: 01 Service includes Processing Powder Coated Box C-51A-P1/P2, Processing of Powder Coated Box C- 51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A P1, Box C-51A P2 etc.) As per ter ms and conditions of attached Annexure “A” for Qty. 29895 nos. Firm has to quote accordingly. SUBMISSION OF COMPLIANCE AS PER BID CONDITIONS AND ACCEPTANCE OF ATC 1. Specification : 01 service includes Processing Powder Coated Box C-51A-P1/P2, Processing of Powder Coated Box C-51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A P1, Box C-51A P2 etc.) As per terms and conditions of attached Annexure “A” for Qty. 29895 nos. Firm has to quote accordin gly. 2. Scope of work/Terms and Conditions : As per Annexure “A” attached. 3. Delivery Period : As per GeM 4. Option Clause : As per GeM. 5. Earnest Money Deposit : As per GeM. 6. Performance Security Deposit : As per GeM. 7. Pre-Qualification Criteria : As per Annexure attached. 8. Warranty : Compliance of warranty for minimum 12 months period from final acceptance date of materi al. 9. Payment Terms : Payment will be made on monthly basis within 30 days after submission of Job Comple tion Certificate (JCC) along with the supporting documents i.e. Tax Invoice and submission of Tax Return/IF F on GST portal. 10. Non-involvement in cartel formation : We hereby give an undertaking that we will not be a part of cart el with other vendors and will be quoting competitive rates in the tenders invited by the YANTRA INDIA LIM ITED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL. 11. Bidder Financial Standing : We hereby give an undertaking that “We are not under liquidation, court re ceivership or similar proceeding and not bankrupt”. 12. Inspection :Authorized representative of ED/OFBH on receipt of material at O.F. Bhusawal. 13. SAFETY NORMS: The firm shall fulfill all safety norms of OFBH and shall provide all necessary PPEs as p er requirement of the job. During execution of work if Firm’s employees are not following safety norms or f ound without required PPEs, then penalty of Rs. 1000/- per incident will be charge. Penalty amount will be deducted by concern user section at the time of preparation of JCC 14. ATC Clause : I accept all Bid terms & conditions along with Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms & Conditio ns(ATC) and also, Buyer Added Text Based ATC clauses as per above referred GEM Bid. ANNEXURE -“A” Works details Terms & Condition for Processing of Powder Coated Box-C-51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-5 1A P-1, Box C-51A P-2 etc. 1. SCOPE OF WORK :- 1. The firm has to carry out the job in Ordnance Factory Bhusawal premises. 2. The firm shall provide adequate laborers of required skill to carry out the job as per scope of work, along with minimum one Technical Supervisor to monitor and control the work. 3. Subject services include following operations:

a. Collection of white stage Box C51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A -P-1, Box C-51A-P-2, etc.) from production area, stacking in battery truck/ hand trolley vehicle and send it to loading platform at POWDER COATING PLANT. b. Collection of painted BOX C51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A-P- 1, Box C-51A-P-2, etc.) from POWDER COATING PLANT, stacking in battery truck /hand trolley vehicle and bring it to shop stacking area (area are to be decided by shop Rep). c. Spreading of Powder coated painted box on painting plate form. d. Cleaning of dust & dirt etc. e. Fixing of Rivets with webbing cotton & Strengthening Plate f. Fixing of foam & Capcell to the body by using adhesive as shown in assembly Drawing of Box C-51A ((All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A-P-1, Box C-51A-P-2, etc.) g. Paint Touch up where ever required on the Box. h. Fixing of Sealing Wire to the Catches. i. Stenciling, Stamping & final inspection of Boxes by inspection authority. j. If a BOX C51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A-P-1, Box C-51A-P-2, etc.) is rectified by welding then cleaning of welded area, application of red oxide on welded area, allowing drying, then painting O.G. on repaired area, matching of the shade properly will be done by Contractor. k. Arranging final inspection & Testing by QC. l. Arranging final acceptance from QC. m. Contractor has to carry out rectification relating to surface treatment. In case of any welding defect (wh ich will be rectified by factory) painting of affected area of the Box will be done by contractor. 4. Collection of Raw Material, components etc from Store/Shop Floor and shifting to the work place. 5. Assisting Ordnance Factory Bhusawal Quality department, Bhusawal for conducting stage Inspection an d Final Inspection. 6. Minor rectification during in-process of final inspection , if any. 7. Cleaning of work area daily and maintaining good housekeeping. 8. Shifting of final product from place of manufacture to storage area. NOTE: - Loose components & raw materials will be supplied by the Factory. 2) WORK SHIFT :- 1. The firm shall carry out subject job daily inside the factory from 8.00 AM up to 5.00 PM (with 45 Minutes lunch from 12.30 Hours to 13.15 Hours). 2. The shift time may vary round the clock as per the availability of the infrastructure. 3. The firm may be asked to work in more than one shift. 3) DELIVERY :- 1. The firm should have capacity to give Minimum 300 nos of Box C51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular , Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A-P-1, Box C-51A-P-2, etc.) per day per shift. 2. In case of increased demand of BOX C51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Bo x C-51A-P-1, Box C-51A-P-2, etc.) the contractor will have to provide adequate number of workers to meet the day to day requirement. 4) QUALITY :- 1. The final job must comply to the quality requirements of Ordnance Factory Bhusawal 2. Rectification: - Rectification, if any, shall have to be carried out by the firm. The rectification job shall no t be counted separately. 5) MATERIAL & INFRASTRUCTURE :- Ordnance Factory Bhusawal shall provide : 1. Necessary finished/Semi finished components. 2. Basic consumables like Aerosol, Paint, Thinner, Kerosene etc. 3. All testing facilities and equipments. 4. Any Loss or damage to the Infrastructure shall have to be borne by the firm. 5. Hand trolley for other vehicle as per availability will be provided by OFBh. 6) SAFETY & STATUTORY REQUIREMENTS :- 1. The firm shall fulfill all safety norms and shall provide necessary safety equipments (PPEs) e.g. gloves, s hoes, goggles, mask etc. as per the requirement of the job to the operator. 2. The firm shall fulfill all security requirements and shall not violate any of the rules and regulations of the factory. 3. The firm must arrange for Police verification of labourers, which the firm is going to engage for subject w ork and submit the PVR to Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. 4. The concerned contractor must submit medical fitness certificate, group insurance certificate, EPF, ESIC, etc. of contract labourers before entering into factory for working. 5. The firm has to follow all labour laws and statutory rules applicable for above job e.g. Minimum Wages A ct, Child Labour Act etc 6. Ordnance Factory Bhusawal shall not be responsible for any loss/damage to the firm and/or his men/ma chines during the course of the work. 7. In case of any dispute, decision of the Executive Director, O.F. Bhusawal will be final and binding. 7)MAINTENANCE OF RECORDS :- The firm shall maintain following records on daily basis (or at appropriat

e frequency as per case), which must be endorsed by Representative of Ordnance Factory Bhusawal :- 1. BOX C51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A-P-1, Box C-51A-P-2, etc. ) Components, raw material etc received from Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. 2. Numbers, Name and Signatures of the Workmen reporting. 3. Number of BOX C51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A-P-1, Box C-5 1A-P-2, etc.) submitted for final passing. 4. Number of BOX C51A (All versions like Box C-51A regular, Box C-51A (Modified), Box C-51A-P-1, Box C- 51A-P-2, etc.) cleared in final passing. 8) Idle time of laborers due to any reason, shall have to be borne by contractor. 9) It is recommended that before quoting, the firm should visit Ordnance Factory Bhusawal to understand t he job requirement and real assessment of work. 10) PENALTY :- If the firm is not able to deliver as per the delivery requirement mentioned above, they ar e liable for penalty of 1/3rd of the Supply Order job Rate per box per day limited to the maximum of total Supply Order rate of the Job. 11. The firm shall report along with men within a week of placing supply order and shall start the job imme diately. 12. The firm shall make their own necessary arrangements for stay in the Bhusawal city. For any other rules and regulations pertaining to this bid will be applicable as per latest YIL Store Procurem ent manual available of YIL site : yantraindia.co.in/en/e-library In case of any query/information please contact at ofbhpvmm@ord.gov.in or 02582-222552,222907, Extn 241 . 6.
